tournament.title: Cold-to-Hot Tumor Microenvironment Reprogramming via Innate Immune Checkpoint Inhibition
tournament.goal: Identify and rank genetically and structurally tractable small-molecule targets that convert immunologically cold (T-cell excluded) solid tumors into hot (CXCL9/CXCL10+, CD8+ T-cell inflamed) tumors to overcome anti-PD-1 resistance.

preferences: Prioritize extracellular or druggable catalytic pockets tractable to oral Rule-of-5 small molecules
Enforce human loss-of-function genetic safety in gnomAD v4 (reject targets with severe germline autoimmune phenotypes)
Preserve extracellular 2',3'-cGAMP to activate paracrine STING -> TBK1 -> IRF3 -> Type I IFN & CXCL9/CXCL10

ideas.title: Extracellular ENPP1 catalytic PDE pocket blockade preserving tumor-derived 2',3'-cGAMP for paracrine APC STING activation

review_references.title: Regulation of the innate immune system by ENPP1 hydrolysis of 2'3'-cGAMP
ENPP1 is an innate immune checkpoint that promotes metastasis by hydrolyzing extracellular cGAMP

claims.claim: ENPP1 is the dominant extracellular hydrolase of 2',3'-cGAMP and dampens paracrine STING signaling in cold tumors.
claims.source_sentence: ENPP1 hydrolyzes extracellular 2'3'-cGAMP to prevent anti-tumor STING activation.
claims.reasoning: Verified in Li et al. Nat Chem Biol 2014 (PMID:25344818) and Carozza et al. Nat Cancer 2020 (PMID:33328268).

references.title: Regulation of the innate immune system by ENPP1 hydrolysis of 2'3'-cGAMP

prose.summary: Selective oral inhibition of the extracellular ENPP1 zinc-dependent phosphodiesterase pocket prevents hydrolysis of immunotransmitter 2',3'-cGAMP without systemic STING agonist toxicity.
prose.description: Chromosomally unstable cold tumors continuously export 2',3'-cGAMP, which is degraded extracellularly by ENPP1. Blocking ENPP1 with oral quinazoline-piperazine sulfamide oase_enpp1_009 restores paracrine dendritic-cell STING signaling and CXCL9/CXCL10 T-cell recruitment.
prose.reviews_summary: Rank #1 target: combines a deep Zn2+ catalytic pocket (P22413), benign human heterozygous LoF tolerance in gnomAD, and tumor-localized cGAMP substrate dependence.
prose.verification_summary: All biochemical, structural, and human genetic claims verified against gnomAD v4, PDB/AlphaFold P22413, and literature.

ideas.title: ADAR1 deaminase domain inhibition to derepress endogenous dsRNA MDA5/MAVS interferon signaling

review_references.title: Loss of ADAR1 in tumours overcomes resistance to immune checkpoint blockade

prose.summary: Inhibiting ADAR1 p150 A-to-I editing triggers dsRNA sensing via MDA5 and sensitizes immunotherapy-resistant tumors.
prose.description: Strong CRISPR loss-of-function synergy with anti-PD-1, but highly polar IP6-coordinated catalytic pocket limits oral small-molecule tractability.
prose.reviews_summary: Strong biology (PMID:30566885), secondary chemical tractability relative to ENPP1.

ideas.title: PTPN2 active-site/allosteric phosphatase inhibition to amplify IFN-gamma JAK1/STAT1 signaling

review_references.title: In vivo CRISPR screening identifies Ptpn2 as a cancer immunotherapy target

prose.summary: Retained as intracellular backup target (`PTPN2-Backup-Series`, benchmarked against ABBV-CLS-484).
prose.description: Amplifies both tumor-cell IFNGR/STAT1 antigen presentation and CD8+ T-cell fitness.

ideas.title: KDM1A (LSD1) histone demethylase inhibition to reactivate endogenous retroelements

prose.summary: Parked due to clinical on-target thrombocytopenia (`L-002`).
prose.description: Hematopoietic progenitor toxicity limits chronic combination dosing.

ideas.title: TREX1 cytosolic exonuclease inhibition to accumulate cytosolic dsDNA

review_references.title: Mutations in the gene encoding the 3'-5' DNA exonuclease TREX1 cause Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome

prose.summary: Disqualified (`L-001`): human TREX1 loss-of-function causes Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome and systemic lupus myocarditis.
prose.description: Rejected at Stage 1 human genetic safety gate.
